## Activity

River Outreach completed 81 captures during June 2019. This activity provides the basis for the period’s image-quality and grading review. The recorded volume should be considered alongside the quality findings below when assessing the site’s operational performance. Any recurring camera issues should continue to be logged with the service desk so that they can be reviewed and addressed through the appropriate support process.

## Image quality

Of the captures completed, 11 were marked ungradable. The ungradable rate was 13.6 per cent of captures. This result should be monitored in routine site reporting, particularly where image-quality concerns recur. Consistent logging of camera problems may assist in identifying issues affecting image usability and support follow-up with the service desk.

## Grading

There were 2 referable results during the reporting period. The median grading wait was 0. The grading outcome and turnaround information should be reviewed with the image-quality findings as part of ongoing operational monitoring. Further action should focus on maintaining capture quality and ensuring that recurring camera issues are recorded through the established service desk process.
